title: F1 2005 Boat
description: This is a Formula 1 2005 texturepack by AdamixGaming, NotGatoz  and Jerpix | required OptiFine!!!
body:
Mercedes Safety Car
  
    All boat with chest (with bamboo raft)

    No command is needed to spawn the Safety Car

oak_boat

    Ferrari 1,2

spruce_boat

    Minardi 20,21
    
    (other version - BAR 3,4)

birch_boat

    Renault 5,6

jungle_boat

    RedBull 14,15

acacia_boat

    Mclaren 9,10

dark_oak_boat

    Toyota 16,17

cherry_boat

    Jordan 18,19

mangrove_boat

    Williams 7,8

bamboo_raft

    Sauber 11,12



(If new version )

 pale_oak

    BAR 3,4

**How to specify**

    Fixed version only

/summon boat ~ ~ ~ {Type:"<oak | spruce | birch | jungle | acacia | dark_oak | cherry | mangrove | bamboo | pale_oak (new version)>",CustomName:"\"<car number>_<slick | wet>\""}

Example

/summon boat ~ ~ ~ {Type:"spruce",CustomName:"\"11_slick\""}


We encourage you to download and test our texturepack ;)
